name: Streptomycin
executiveSummary: Antituberculous aminoglycoside. Adult TB: **15 mg/kg IM/day** (usual **0.75–1 g/day**; max **1 g**). Pediatrics: **15–20 mg/kg/day** (max **1 g**). Prefer IM; oto/nephrotoxicity — levels and hearing.
indications:
## Indications

- Tuberculosis (always in combination; 2nd-line / resistance per program).
- Some enterococcal / brucella regimens historically (rare today).

## Precautions

- Vestibular/cochlear ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity — audiometry and creatinine.
- Adjust in renal failure. Teratogenic (pregnancy).
- IV only if IM not tolerated and with ID (dilute; infuse 30–60 min).

> Never monotherapy in TB.

adulto.dose: Daily TB: **15 mg/kg IM** (usual **0.75–1 g**) **every 24 h**. Intermittent: **20–25 mg/kg** 2–3×/week (max **1–1.5 g**/dose per program). Usual daily max **1 g**.
adulto.administration: Deep IM after reconstituting ~4.5 mL SW/NS (≈100 mg/mL). Exceptional IV: 1 g in 100 mL NS over 30–60 min.

pediatrico.dose: **15–20 mg/kg/day** IM (max **1 g/day**). Neonates: only if no alternative — ID/NNU.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Vertigo, hearing loss, nephrotoxicity, perioral paresthesias, IM site reactions, hypersensitivity.
